name: safeguards documented-subset recognition
description: src/safeguards (trellis-a97d): configuration-only inspection with explicit evidence levels. Recognition is a documented SUBSET: run refs (bun|npm|pnpm|yarn run <name>), check commands (biome/eslint; tsc --noEmit only; bun test/vitest/jest), repo-local path tokens (must contain a slash; URLs/flags/assignments/env vars/absolute paths excluded) — anything else stays unverified, never guessed. Broken-reference checks use pathExists (file OR directory; a core.hooksPath dir is a valid target) while surface detection uses fileExists. Evidence merges by rank structurally-wired > configured > unknown > absent. Executable runners (bun scripts/check-all.ts) stop CI-reachability: a check reachable only through one stays configured.

name: compare-module-io-seam
description: src/compare/ (trellis-942c): load.ts is the only I/O (operational ReportArtifactError → exit 1), compare.ts and policy.ts are pure over validated AuditReports. Compatibility is a hard gate (schema/analyzer/scoring version, metric-set, supplied source configs) refusing to compute deltas; unverifiable config and changed source scope are explicit caveats. Finding matching is conservative: kind+path 1:1 pairs persistent (line shift recorded), n:m groups become resolved+new pairs. Baseline-dependent policies skip on absent baseline but fail closed on incompatible baseline; budgets fail closed on unknown metric ids, skip on value-less metrics.

title: Surface services compose around the pure audit pass
rationale: Keeps auditWorkspace's SPEC §8 invariants (no DB/network/Git) intact while giving CLI and SDK exactly one code path per operation.

title: Provider evidence follows the deterministic foundation
rationale: Plan pl-43c5 sequences optional engineering-quality evidence after completion of pl-b2ea through parent trellis-253e. Providers initially remain unscored, preserve independent evidence and score completeness, and use controlled opt-in execution. The plan adopts trellis-06f8 as its contract task and explicitly gates Sonar integration on distribution and metric-interface clearance or documented deferral. This records planned work, not implemented capabilities.

title: Native cleanup reuses provider provenance contracts
rationale: The required primitives and per-basis compatibility are already delivered, so remaining external adapters need not block native cleanup.

title: Native cleanup detail retains provider provenance boundaries
rationale: Schema 1.2.0 adds native source/config snapshots and typed finding identity without changing native metrics, scoring or provider analysis ownership. Ambiguous moves, collisions, lost scope and partial analysis cannot establish cleanup.

name: saved-finding-inspection
description: Explain is a core saved-artifact service reused by CLI and SDK. It bounds sections with explicit omissions and makes workspace enrichment opt-in with exact source fingerprints, contained regular-file reads and visible stale/unavailable states. Instruction locations are discovery context, never executable configuration.

name: bounded-cleanup-guidance
description: Build cleanup opportunities from saved native references and graph context. Group same-file hotspot functions, retain native clone/cycle groups, order categorically rather than by invented effort, and name direct-import or basename test associations without coverage claims. Context-edge limits never truncate scored graph analysis or complete cycle evidence.

name: focused-subthreshold-feedback
description: Retain compact below-threshold measurements from the existing complexity pass with explicit retention/fingerprint limits. Focused comparison expands selected files to direct local dependencies, associates unique lexical slots conservatively, and exposes helpers/moves and unmatched baselines without equating disappearance with improvement. Keep function text identity distinct from native finding structural identity.

name: reconsiderable-native-dispositions
description: Keep operator dispositions in explicit versioned storage, outside audit. Freshness fingerprints the selected native finding, affected source/config/parser and relevant graph evidence; stale or unavailable annotations cannot hide queue items. Lock and atomically replace stores, preserve raw findings and policy, and expose filtering counts independently.

name: shared-lexical-owner-traversal
description: Native finding identity and compact function feedback use the same lexical owner vocabulary. Centralize that traversal in the syntax layer while preserving unbounded finding identity and explicitly bounded feedback ownership. This removes duplicate logic even when the normalized clone detector and headline score do not move.
Real cleanup validation moved lexical ownership into a helper exported through syntax/index.ts; direct-only focused context omitted the new helper and overstated local reduction.
resolution: Focused scope now follows measured re-export chains with a cycle-safe visited set. The regression covers chained and cyclic barrels and retains below-threshold helpers without inferring call relationships.

title: Accept cleanup on reviewed code benefit, not hotspot disappearance
rationale: pl-d028 real validation kept shared lexical ownership in Trellis with index 41 unchanged, and reverted Warren hardestDirectory extraction despite 12/12 gates and 512 equivalence cases because it added a single-use helper without removing duplication or improving a boundary. The trial removed one hotspot but kept index 70 and increased combined CC 11 to 12. Record attempted-and-reverted outcomes explicitly; independent calibration remains trellis-f999 and large-workspace RSS follow-up is trellis-92b4.

title: Bounded native suffix indexing
rationale: Use original iterative prefix doubling with counting sort and Kasai LCP; explicit reservations and deterministic slot charges provide bounded indexing without recursive source-length stack growth or a runtime Fallow dependency.

name: equal-length-clone-containment
description: Members of one exact-content clone group have equal token lengths, so cannot strictly contain one another. Across eligible groups a file/start/end sweep preserves strict containment and single-pass subsumption in O(m log m), avoiding nested group-member scans.

title: Use induced sorting under the frozen native work cap
rationale: Prefix doubling passed small differential tests but exhausted the pinned Zod test corpus before extraction. Original guarded SA-IS reduced Zod test work to 73.1M under the unchanged 100M cap; keep corpus acceptance ahead of native cutover and never raise limits to pass.

content: Current trellis contains deterministic audit execution, report renderers and opt-in audit history. Native analysis uses metrics over shared syntax; CLI/SDK/fleet call the same core. SPEC and AGENTS define the current architecture. New databases create audit_runs only; opening existing databases leaves unrelated tables untouched. Provider fixture evidence and pinned tool metadata remain available independently of production-source research snapshots.
